official_product_identity: 2024 TIGER/Line Shapefile, Census Tracts, Wisconsin (state FIPS 55)
source_geography_and_type: Wisconsin statewide Census Tracts TIGER/Line ZIP archive; required as GEO's upstream public source evidence only.

retrieval.method: HTTPS GET of the exact source_reference URL; do not use a Current service, TIGERweb output, another release, or a transformed derivative.

checksum_semantics: SHA-256 over the exact downloaded tl_2024_55_tract.zip bytes before extraction or interpretation.

expected_file_properties.expected_crs_reference: NAD83 geographic coordinates as described by the supplied TIGER/Line projection metadata; this manifest does not establish GEO transformation-operation authority.

reproduction: Download exactly source_reference as bytes, require the exact filename, byte length, ZIP entries, and SHA-256 above. A different result is a checksum-rejected retrieval and must not be substituted or normalized.
failure_behavior: Fail closed on an unavailable URL, filename/product/vintage mismatch, byte-length mismatch, missing required ZIP entry, missing required source field, or SHA-256 mismatch. Record checksum_rejected; do not continue with a later TIGER release, TIGERweb, Current service, or derivative.

lineage.controlling_decision: DATA-01: Accepted Public Data Source Decisions
lineage.geo_boundary: This is source evidence only. GEO owns the canonical tract-inventory derivation specification.

supersession_policy: A correction or new accepted release requires a new manifest ID/version and explicit supersedes lineage; never overwrite this accepted manifest.
